pr_title: Overhaul decoration traits and implement isometric selection boxes
pr_body: This PR has two major parts: * Giving the decoration traits their long-delayed overhaul, removing accrued technical debt and reducing a lot of unnecessary duplication (first 6 commits). This also allows mods to define their own selection boxes, and removes the assumptions about selection boxes being rectangular. * Introducing hexagonal selection boxes for TS structures, both for rendering and for mouse interaction. The selection box heights are automatically ported from the original art.ini (see the `CopyIsometricSelectableHeight` update rule) - some of the original sizes are weird, but i'd prefer we deferred polishing these to a followup PR. Fixes #4783. Closes #17346. I strongly recommend reviewing by commit to keep this manageable.

Updated to add `DecorationBounds` and `DecorationHeight` fields. A "TS Classic" style mod can now define `Height: 0` and e.g. `DecorationHeight: 48` to reproduce the legacy behaviour. This feels like a step back in usability IMO, so I don't want to enable this in the default mod unless we have a very good reason to need it.

Also fixed the voice support for isometric selectables (will eventually be needed by the mobile war factories) by adding `Voice` to the new `ISelectableInfo` interface.

There are uses for this such as when you want to move units behind buildings but end up either selecting the building or attacking it. I know pressing alt allows you to move behind buildings but it is something you might not remember to press when playing.

I think it remains to be seen whether the cells-behind-building issue is a problem in practice: I haven't seen any complaints about the selection overlap being a game breaking issue in SP or RV, and this PR improves the situation massively by cutting the corners off the previously square selection boxes. Splitting the selection and decoration bounds breaks the behaviour of the rollover health bar.

issue_context.title: Support hiding the ammo pips as long as Armaments are disabled
issue_context.body:
The part of #13013 that wasn't resolved by #13538.

Support hiding the ammo pips of a pool if all linked armaments are disabled.

review_comments: Just noting that the centroid need not be the same as the bounding box center. An example is a regular pentagon, which is also an example of radial symmetry since all regular polygons have rotational symmetry. Polygons with rotational symmetry of a degree divisible by four and polygons with both horizontal and vertical symmetry such as the isometric and dimetric projections of a cube do have the center of their bounding boxes as their centroids. The TS mod w is an example. Modders should avoid shapes that deviate too much from those two sets since that would cause irregularities in selection edge cases.

I believe it is best to leave this as is for performance. I just want to note that code will have to be audited for changes to vertices after construction, since the bounding rectangle and rectangle and rectangle flag would fall out of sync.

Maybe i'm missing something, but both `Rectangle` and `int2` are immutable so this shouldn't be possible?

Edit: ah I see, by replacing the array element. If someone intentionally does this then they deserve to have things break :D
